c. 1903 et seq.
The following is a faithful transcription of the original handwritten notes by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap. - his Notebook No. 2.
This Notebook contains some Newspaper Clippings, Latin Notes plus Homilies etc. written in English as follows:
Pg. 1.
(Clipping pasted over Latin notes)
Our Sunday Visitor, February 4, 1917
Article: Irene West Tells How She Converted a Friend
Pg. 2. Irene West article continued. (pasted over Latin notes.)
Pg. 3.
Irene West article concluded.
Also a poem: "The Prodigal Girl"
(pasted over Latin notes. )
Pg. 4.
Article entitled, "Hebrew Scholar Says
It is The World's Greatest Asset."
(pasted over Latin notes.)
Pg. 5. Article continued from page 4. (pasted over Latin notes.)
Pg. 6.
Latin Notes, perhaps from an earlier
date while a student.
(Handwriting seems to be that of Fr. Solanus Casey)
